sourceRefs.locator: Full front, 2,359 × 2,156 pixels. Central face, 500 francs nominal and 250 paid. Figures labelled North and South America, right-to-subscribe stamp above, Bayonne receipts for February and September 1886 below. The 1880 dates printed at the top concern the statutes. Public-domain statement on the file page.

labels.en: Bearer share no. 278792 of the French canal company

alt.de: Die Aktie nennt einen Nennwert von 500 Francs. Unter den Figuren Nord- und Südamerikas tragen zwei Quittungen den Ortsnamen Bayonne und handschriftliche Daten aus dem Jahr 1886.
alt.en: The certificate has a face value of 500 francs. Beneath the figures of North and South America, two receipts bear the place name Bayonne and handwritten dates in 1886.
